title: With Vendor Order Management Create & Edit, a return's part search works
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a custom role for this test, role B, with Vendor Order Management — View and Vendor Order Management — Create & Edit ticked and every Part Library & Inventory box unticked, so user B reaches parts only through Vendor Order Management.
  • Create a staff member for this test, user B, at the test location with role B, so the steps run with role B's permissions.
  • Use a second browser window (a private window) signed in as user B.
  • Have a vendor, vendor A, and an inactive part, part A, with vendor A.
custom_steps:
1. In the second window, click Parts in the top bar.
  2. Click Returns in the left menu.
  3. Click the button that starts a new return.
  4. Pick vendor A in the Vendor field.
  5. Type the first half of part A's part number in the Part Number field.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Parts left menu opens for user B.

Step 2:

  • The Returns list opens.

Step 3:

  • The Create Return page opens.

Step 4:

  • Vendor A is shown.

Step 5:

  • Part A is offered, with its grey "Inactive" tag, and no access error appears: Create & Edit on Vendor Order Management includes viewing parts.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work), story SV-10825 (Story 12, Call the Shared Parts List the Part Library)

  • S9-N3a: “Opening Parts → Returns and starting a vendor return keep the access today's 'Vendor Order Management' settings give. This feature adds, removes and changes no permission (S12-N1). 'Vendor Order Management → Create & Edit' includes 'Part Library & Inventory → View', so a role with it can search for parts on a return.”
  • S9-N3: “Picking parts on a vendor return or a vendor credit needs the 'Part Library & Inventory → View' permission, as it does today. Without it the part search there shows the standard access error.”
  • S12-N1: “No permission is added, removed or re-keyed. Every user's access on release day is identical to the day before.”

From: Jira tickets and comments under epic SV-10647 (saved in sources/jira-2026-10-27/ALL-TICKETS-2026-10-27.md), read 27 Oct 2026

  • SV-10822, Chris Ward, 23 Oct 2026: “Confirmed: A. Leave the role bundles as they are. This epic adds, removes and re-keys no permissions (S12-N1). S9-N3a will be reworded to describe today's bundles, and any split of View vs Create & Edit for returns would be its own ticket.”
